name: Nandith Narayan
title: Alumni · Research Assistant
bio: He is a senior in Florida Tech’s undergraduate computer science degree program. His interests are in machine learning, mathematics, digital logic, and physics. He is currently working as a research assistant on a research program with NASA on assurance for increasingly autonomous systems. His hobbies include video games, circuit design, amateur model rocketry, and general space enthusiasm. In his spare time, he likes to build digital logic circuits on breadboards; he also likes to implement interesting machine learning algorithms such as NEAT to autonomously play games.
